reason: My boys have worked with a phone call and a paper bill for years, and I don't believe 7 out of 10 jobs will ever go through an app, so the free month will just end with nothing. Calling them costs me nothing, and ₹2,499 every month for my size of team is real money next to WhatsApp, which is free.
objection: My technicians will not use an app; they barely read English, and when they're up on a ladder on a hot day they won't stop to press a button and talk to a phone. Then I'm the one chasing them to use it, on top of chasing them about the jobs.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing with my own eyes another Chennai AC shop of my size where the ordinary technicians, not the smart young ones, really use it on every job, and the owner tells me it cut down his phone calls.
